bottleneck.summary: Small source Eli Tc gain12.132 versus11.632K, q5x5x2 versus4^3. Target fine force0.0248561eV/A and maxstress0.371GPa are geometry/grid sensitivity, whereas source finite-grid target energy is8.488meV/atom lower. No uniform force threshold or global-ground-state requirement is used. Evaluated risks define a falsifiable bounded hypothesis, not an established bulk ground state or experimental coherence proof.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source nearambient fullstress/pressure and coarse-relaxed geometry, positive raw-Gamma optical compression beyond printing bounds, and no negative printed finite-path values support preliminary local feasibility only within the declared source approximation. WholeBZ/global hull/synthesis remain unknown.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Unique Ti/Mo periodic distance3.20425449 versus4.54011919A and Ti-Mo nearest3.24879784 versus3.21034907A; non-alias ordering with0.80722% lower control volume. Computed source EPC response is associated with construction; pure geometry-only causality and converged numerical uplift are unproved.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Check target stationarity on matched fine sampling and preserve ordering; only add response calculation that resolves the existing EPC ordering if necessary.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
